name: models3d_generate
description: Image-to-3D GLB. Upload external images first. Rig with `models3d_rig`, then animate with `models3d_animate`.

creationIdentifier.description: Source image identifier. Optional when `views` is set.

enablePbr.description: hunyuan-v3.1-pro: PBR maps on the texture, for a higher price. Default false.

faceLimit.description: Faces. tripo-p1: 100..20,000 (default 10,000); tripo-p2: 100..50,000 (default 10,000); tripo-v31: up to 2,000,000. Meshy: 1,000..300,000, enables remeshing; meshy-t2: 1,000..15,000, set directly. hi3d-v3.0: 100,000..5,000,000; other Hi3D: 100,000..2,000,000. Omit for model default.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

generateParts.description: tripo-v31 only: hand back the mesh split into separate parts. Forces texture off; defaults model to tripo-v31.

model.description: Default tripo-p1. tripo-v31 is Tripo H3.1. tripo-p2 is Tripo's Preview of the next low-poly engine. meshy-t2 is Smart Topology: cleaner topology, natively separated parts, lower face count. meshy-7 is deprecated; prefer meshy-7.1. hi3d-portrait-v2.1 is tuned for people and characters.

textureQuality.description: Tripo/Meshy/Hi3D/Hunyuan: standard default; detailed only tripo-v31 and tripo-p2.

views.description: Multiview, Tripo/Meshy/Hi3D/Hunyuan: 2-4 of front/left/back/right → source image identifiers. Replaces creationIdentifier; Hunyuan needs a front.
